title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: schema recommendations for custom connectors in the admin centre
summary: Hold: the briefing says existing behaviour will not change even though Microsoft has not stated what happens on arrival. The documented recommendations, admin route, schema API and general licensing are supported, but the assurances about unchanged behaviour and who must apply changes go beyond the sources.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center provides schema recommendations for published custom Copilot connectors.
claims.quote: To help you get started, the Microsoft 365 admin center provides schema recommendations for published custom connectors.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Recommendations analyse the schema and highlight missing semantic labels used to understand, rank and cite content.
claims.quote: Schema recommendations analyze your connector schema and highlight missing semantic labels for key properties that Copilot relies on to understand, rank, and cite content.

claims.claim: The four-label check includes the missing title semantic label.
claims.quote:
Schema recommendations currently check for four missing semantic labels:

- **`title`**

claims.claim: The four-label check includes the missing url semantic label.
claims.quote: **`url`** – Identifies the canonical link to the source item. Required for Copilot citations to link back to the source system.

claims.claim: The four-label check includes the missing lastModifiedBy semantic label.
claims.quote: **`lastModifiedBy`** – Identifies who last updated an item. Improves attribution in Copilot responses.

claims.claim: The four-label check includes the missing lastModifiedDateTime semantic label.
claims.quote: **`lastModifiedDateTime`** – Indicates when an item was last updated. Enables Copilot to reason over recency and answer time-based questions.

claims.claim: Schema recommendations are not exhaustive.
claims.quote: Schema recommendations aren't exhaustive and don't replace the full schema design guidance for Copilot connectors.

claims.claim: Recommendations do not replace full schema design guidance, and Learn links to semantic label guidance.
claims.quote: Schema recommendations aren't exhaustive and don't replace the full schema design guidance for Copilot connectors. For comprehensive schema best practices, property attributes, and semantic label guidance, see Semantic labels.

claims.claim: The admin route to the connection detail panel is Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Connectors > Your Connections > connection.
claims.quote:
Go to Copilot > Connectors > Your Connections.
Select the connection that you want to modify.
Schema recommendations can be accessed via the connection detail panel.

claims.claim: An API to read schema recommendations or switch them off is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph schema recommendations custom connectors read recommendations API beta disable setting. Read manage-connector, the schema PATCH reference, and beta externalConnection and schema resource references. No recommendation property, read API or switch was documented.

claims.claim: An admin UI for adding missing labels to an existing published custom connection's schema is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 admin center custom connector update existing schema semantic labels Assign property labels; custom connector published edit schema admin center. Read manage-connector and schema guide; results document Microsoft-built schema editing and custom SDK publishing, not this update.

claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/external/connections/{id}/schema creates or updates the connection schema.

claims.where: controls[0].note; summary; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The connectors management documentation requires an AI administrator to access and manage connectors.
claims.quote: To access and manage your Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors, you must be an AI administrator for your organization.

claims.claim: The Graph connection guide instead says a search admin can view and manage all tenant connections.
claims.quote: A search admin can view and manage all the connections in the tenant via the Copilot > Agents and connectors section of the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Learn says the title label is required for meaningful rendering and relevant Copilot results.
claims.quote: **`title`** – Semantically indexes the primary display name of an item. Required for meaningful result rendering and relevant Copilot results.

claims.claim: Learn says the url label is required for citations linking back to the source system.
claims.quote: **`url`** – Identifies the canonical link to the source item. Required for Copilot citations to link back to the source system.

claims.claim: Deployed connectors are tenant-wide unless external item security is restricted.
claims.quote: Deployed connectors are tenant-wide unless external item security is restricted.

claims.claim: Semantic labels can be added or removed from an existing schema.
claims.quote:
### Add or remove a semantic label

You can assign or remove semantic labels.

claims.claim: The recommendations are not a change to existing behaviour, so nobody needs to act before they appear.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors schema recommendations automatically change schema apply recommendations. Read manage-connector and schema guide; also searched recommendations' default and rollout. Neither source states that existing behaviour is unchanged on arrival.
claims.fix: Replace 'The recommendations are guidance rather than a change to existing behaviour, so nobody needs to act before they appear.' with 'No source says existing behaviour changes, so plan for the connector developer to review the guidance rather than assuming a required pre-rollout change.' Keep defaultState as unknown.

claims.claim: A person or an application still has to change the schema rather than the recommendations making changes.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors schema recommendations automatically change schema apply recommendations; schema recommendations Copilot read-only automatically. Read manage-connector, schema guide and PATCH reference. They document highlighting and schema updates, not this mandatory intervention rule.
claims.fix: Replace 'A person or an application still has to change the schema.' with 'Microsoft Graph documents a separate operation to change the schema.'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Editing a connection might trigger a full crawl, where applicable.
claims.quote: Editing a connection might trigger a full crawl, where applicable. However, during the initial full crawl, editing the connection doesn't trigger another full crawl. Changes made during the first crawl are applied during the next scheduled full crawl.
claims.fix: Add after the full-crawl statement: 'During the initial full crawl, edits do not trigger another full crawl; changes are applied during the next scheduled full crawl.'

claims.claim: Syncing is the connection state indicating that the connector is crawling.
claims.quote: Syncing - The connector crawls the data from the source to index the existing items and make any updates.
